title: docs(skills): seeds.md says a seeded roll-up value is never stored, not stored as written
body:
Fixes #36122

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用数据技能写演示数据的 AI 作者,读到的说明从「写进汇总字段的数会原样存下」改成「不会存、加载时提醒一次、由子记录算出」。
- 为什么做:平台行为已在上周改掉(种子数据不再存汇总值),技能里的理由成了错话,这次让文字跟上已发布的行为。
- 出错会怎样:只改一句说明和一条评测期望;写错了作者会学到错的模型,撤回这次合并即可恢复原文。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md` (the validation-rules paragraph): the rule "Never seed the roll-up" and the record-order point stay. Only the consequence changes, from "a seeded `amount_paid` is stored as written, and a cap on payments refuses those it counts" to "a seeded `amount_paid` is never stored (a warning per dataset); the child rows compute it."
- `skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`, case id 32: `expected_output` now says the seed loader never stores a supplied `amount_paid` and logs one warning per dataset naming the fields. It adds a "does not say a seeded `amount_paid` is stored or makes the rule refuse the payments" line. `prompt`, `must_contain` and `must_not_contain` (`amount_paid: 4800`, `amount_paid: 2000`) are unchanged, so the case still requires invoice rows with no roll-up value.
- `.changeset/36122-seeds-rollup-never-stored.md`: `patch` on `@objectstack/skills`, as earlier skills-text changes carry.

Shipped behaviour the sentence states, read at `packages/metadata-protocol/src/seed-loader.ts` on `origin/main` bbc7e037f3:

- lines 794-801 (`summaryFieldNames`): only fields with `type === 'summary'` are taken out, every aggregate, `readonly` or not. Formula and autonumber fields have no such path in the loader.
- lines 2304-2311: the value is deleted from the record copy before the replay compare and before the engine write, so no validation rule ever sees it.
- lines 3268-3277: one `logger.warn` per dataset, naming the object, the fields and the count of values not written.

Read first: the one changed sentence in `seeds.md`, then eval case 32.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` prints `skills/objectstack-data/references/seeds.md is 1898 tokens (ceiling 1898; headroom 0)` and exits 0.

## Tests

Text only: no code or tested behaviour changes, so there is no package test to run and no ablation. The eval file parses as JSON.

## Acceptance notes

- Other evals in the data skill that mention seeding a roll-up: none. A search of `skills/objectstack-data/evals/` for seed cases naming a roll-up, a summary field or `amount_paid` hits case 32 only. The two `task_count` summary cases in the same file (ids near lines 257 and 267) are about read access, not seeding.
- The first wording was one byte over the old sentence; the second commit trims it to one byte under.
- The branch carries one merge of `origin/main` (22 commits, none touching these files).
